Primary Ability: Strength

Siege-born demolisher who channels ruin into righteous reclamation.

Class Features

  • Tier 1: Gain proficiency in Athletics & Mason’s Tools. Ignore nonmagical structure resistance. +3 Violence OP cap.
  • Tier 2: When initiating a Siege, spend 1 less Violence OP.
  • Tier 3: Ruin to Renewal — when you destroy a fortification, you may attempt a Faith or Economy check (DC 15) to purify the ground.
  • Tier 4: Architect of Endings — Violence Attrition penalties halved for your faction.
